sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但她的身份确认，反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Seventy-four-year-old Elizabeth Tershke faced a dilemma.
sentences.zh: 74岁的伊丽莎白·特什克面临着一个两难的抉择。

sentences.en: She had one day left to decide whether or not to put an offer in for a house, but she couldn't make up her mind.
sentences.zh: 她只剩下一天时间来决定是否要买下一栋房子，但她始终拿不定主意。

sentences.en: Someone recommended that Elizabeth speak with a spiritualist who was known to have excellent powers, as they might be able to offer some guidance.
sentences.zh: 有人建议伊丽莎白去咨询一位据说有超凡能力的灵媒，或许能得到一些指引。

sentences.en: Seeing no harm in getting their advice, Elizabeth visited the spiritualist, taking her 12-year-old granddaughter, Alma, as company.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白觉得听听建议也无妨，于是带着12岁的孙女阿尔玛一同前往。

sentences.en: Elizabeth handed the spiritualist papers pertaining to the property.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白将有关房产的文件递给了灵媒。

sentences.en: The spiritualist pressed the papers against her forehead and closed her eyes.
sentences.zh: 灵媒将文件按在额头上，闭上了双眼。

sentences.en: After a moment of quiet contemplation, she advised Elizabeth not to make the purchase.
sentences.zh: 经过片刻的静思，她建议伊丽莎白不要买这处房产。

sentences.en: As long as she was there, Elizabeth thought of something else she'd like guidance on.
sentences.zh: 既然来了，伊丽莎白又想到了另一件需要指引的事。

sentences.en: Alma's mother had died seven years prior from a kidney disorder.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的母亲七年前因肾脏疾病去世了。

sentences.en: Since then, the young girl had been a much-loved companion to Elizabeth.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，这个小女孩就成了伊丽莎白最贴心的伴侣。

sentences.en: But their time together was coming to an end.
sentences.zh: 但她们在一起的时光即将结束。

sentences.en: Alma's father lived in the regional Victorian town of Mafra, 220 kilometres away from Elizabeth's home in Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的父亲住在维多利亚州的马弗拉镇，距离伊丽莎白在墨尔本的家有220公里远。

sentences.en: Plans were underway to send Alma and her younger sister, Viola, to Mafra so their family could reunite.
sentences.zh: 家里正计划把阿尔玛和她妹妹维奥拉送到马弗拉，以便一家团聚。

sentences.en: Elizabeth wasn't against the idea, but the thought of Alma leaving filled her with sadness.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白并不反对这个想法，但一想到阿尔玛要离开，她心中就充满了悲伤。

sentences.en: She asked the spiritualist, if Alma went to Mafra, would she ever come back?
sentences.zh: 她问灵媒，如果阿尔玛去了马弗拉，她还会回来吗？

sentences.en: The spiritualist closed her eyes and had a think.
sentences.zh: 灵媒闭上眼睛沉思了一会儿。

sentences.en: No, she replied.
sentences.zh: “不会了，”她回答道。

sentences.en: Back at school, Alma told her friends about the visit.
sentences.zh: 回到学校后，阿尔玛把这次拜访告诉了朋友们。

sentences.en: They could tell that she was troubled by it.
sentences.zh: 她们看得出来，阿尔玛为此感到困扰。

sentences.en: With a sad face, Alma said the spiritualist told her that she'd die within three months.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛神情忧郁地说，灵媒告诉她，她会在三个月内死去。

sentences.en: Alma's friends dismissed the omen, finding it somewhat funny.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的朋友们觉得这只是个预兆，甚至觉得有点好笑。

sentences.en: But when Elizabeth Tershke was later informed of this, she was confused.
sentences.zh: 但当伊丽莎白·特什克后来得知此事时，她感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: She didn't recall the spiritualist giving any such premonition.
sentences.zh: 她并不记得灵媒曾给出过这样的预言。

sentences.en: Elizabeth wondered, was it a harmless fib Alma told to get attention from her schoolmates, or was it indicative of an unnerving feeling the young girl sensed within herself?
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白纳闷，这到底是阿尔玛为了博取同学关注而编造的无伤大雅的谎言，还是这个小女孩内心深处某种不安感的体现？

sentences.en: The following month of December 1921, Melbourne was abuzz with anticipation for the coming new year.
sentences.zh: 1921年12月，墨尔本沉浸在迎接新年的期待中。

sentences.en: Yet, as night fell on Friday December 30, things were quiet and sombre at a flat on Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 然而，12月30日星期五夜幕降临时，柯林斯街的一间公寓里却显得格外安静沉闷。

sentences.en: Several members of the Tershke family and their loved ones had gathered inside, unable to sleep.
sentences.zh: 几位特什克家族的成员和亲友聚集在屋内，彻夜难眠。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Tershke was among them, sitting in the parlour with a light on and the front door unlocked.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·特什克也在其中，她坐在客厅里，开着灯，大门敞开着。

sentences.en: Minutes after midnight, the door opened.
sentences.zh: 午夜过后几分钟，门开了。

sentences.en: Elizabeth stiffened in anticipation as two police officers walked through the doorway.
sentences.zh: 当两名警察走进门时，伊丽莎白紧张地屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: With bated breath, she asked,
sentences.zh: 她屏息问道：

sentences.en: Have you found my girl?
sentences.zh: “你们找到我的女孩了吗？”

sentences.en: Hours earlier, Alma Tershke had been sent on an errand.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，阿尔玛·特什克被派去跑腿。

sentences.en: Her uncle John worked at a butcher's shop on Swanston Street, a bustling store-lined thoroughfare in the heart of Melbourne's CBD.
sentences.zh: 她的叔叔约翰在斯旺斯顿街的一家肉铺工作，那是一条位于墨尔本中央商务区中心地带、商店林立的繁华街道。

sentences.en: The shop, named Bennett and Woolcox, was just over two kilometres from Alma's grandmother's home in the city-fringe suburb of Jollymont.
sentences.zh: 这家名为“贝内特与伍尔科克斯”的肉铺，距离阿尔玛祖母位于城市边缘郊区乔利蒙特的家只有两公里多。

sentences.en: Alma was to visit the butcher shop, pick up a parcel of meat, and then drop it at her aunt's flat on nearby Collins Street before returning home.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的任务是去肉铺取一包肉，然后送到附近柯林斯街的姑妈公寓，最后回家。

sentences.en: The weekly task was usually carried out by other family members, but they were unavailable and Alma was home for the school holidays, so she was happy to do it.
sentences.zh: 这项每周一次的任务通常由其他家人完成，但他们当时都不在，而阿尔玛正值学校假期在家，所以她很乐意帮忙。

sentences.en: Although Alma hadn't run this errand before, she had travelled into the city multiple times and was familiar with the area.
sentences.zh: 虽然阿尔玛以前没跑过这趟腿，但她多次进城，对那一带很熟悉。

sentences.en: All up, the trip was expected to take no longer than two hours,
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这趟行程预计不会超过两个小时。

sentences.en: Alma was given money for a tram fare, but she decided to walk instead.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛拿了电车费，但她决定步行。

sentences.en: It was a pleasant day and, with plenty of other people moving about and busy traffic passing by, she felt safe to do so.
sentences.zh: 那天天气很好，路上行人熙熙攘攘，交通繁忙，她觉得步行很安全。

sentences.en: Alma took the scenic route through the Fitzroy and Treasury Gardens, arriving at Bennett and Woolcox shortly after 1pm.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛沿着菲茨罗伊花园和财政部花园的风景路线走，下午1点多到达了肉铺。

sentences.en: Alma's uncle John wasn't there, so she spoke to the cashier instead, who gave her the parcel of sausages and corned beef.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的叔叔约翰不在，她便和收银员说了话，收银员给了她一包香肠和咸牛肉。

sentences.en: By the time Alma left for her aunt's flat on Collins Street, it was around 1.30.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛出发前往柯林斯街姑妈公寓时，大约是1点30分。

sentences.en: The flat was just a short walk away, but Alma never showed up.
sentences.zh: 公寓离那儿只有很短的路程，但阿尔玛却再也没有出现。

sentences.en: When she didn't return to Jollymont either, her family grew concerned.
sentences.zh: 当她也没有回到乔利蒙特时，她的家人开始担心起来。

sentences.en: They headed out to trace Alma's steps, but she was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 他们出门寻找阿尔玛的踪迹，却一无所获。

sentences.en: While searching the city,
sentences.zh: 在城里搜寻时，

sentences.en: Alma's uncle John spoke to a police officer, who suggested that Alma might have taken a tram to the beach to enjoy the nice weather.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的叔叔约翰询问了一名警察，对方建议阿尔玛可能坐电车去海边享受好天气了。

sentences.en: But Alma's family weren't convinced.
sentences.zh: 但阿尔玛的家人并不相信。

sentences.en: She hadn't been given enough money for a tram ticket that far.
sentences.zh: 她带的钱根本不够买去那么远地方的电车票。

sentences.en: The officer headed back to the station, where calls were made to nearby hospitals.
sentences.zh: 那名警察回到警局，拨打了附近医院的电话。

sentences.en: Alma hadn't wound up at any of them.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛并没有被送往任何一家医院。

sentences.en: Her loved ones were told to return to the Collins Street flat in case Alma had finally appeared there.
sentences.zh: 她的亲人们被告知先回到柯林斯街的公寓，以防阿尔玛最终出现在那里。

sentences.en: As night time descended with no sign of Alma, her uncle John headed to Victoria Police Headquarters on Russell Street to formally report his niece as missing.
sentences.zh: 夜幕降临，仍不见阿尔玛的踪影，她的叔叔约翰前往罗素街的维多利亚州警察总部，正式报告侄女失踪。

sentences.en: He was assured that a description of Alma would be sent to other stations so that all officers would be on the lookout for the 12-year-old.
sentences.zh: 警方保证会将阿尔玛的体貌特征发往其他警局，以便所有警员都能留意这个12岁的女孩。

sentences.en: The slightly built Alma was 4 foot 10 inches tall with freckles and long golden red hair.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛身材瘦小，身高4英尺10英寸，长着雀斑和一头金红色的长发。

sentences.en: She was wearing her school uniform, which consisted of a box-plated navy blue dress with a white blouse underneath, a white leghorn hat, black stockings, and black shoes.
sentences.zh: 她穿着校服，包括一件海军蓝色的百褶裙，里面配一件白衬衫，戴着一顶白色利古里亚草帽，穿着黑袜子和黑鞋子。

sentences.en: Even though it was the school holidays, this was the nicest outfit Alma owned for a trip into the city.
sentences.zh: 尽管是学校假期，但这却是阿尔玛进城时穿得最好的一套衣服。

sentences.en: The police also made another round of calls to nearby hospitals.
sentences.zh: 警方又对附近医院进行了新一轮的电话询问。

sentences.en: Alma still hadn't been admitted to any of them.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛依然没有出现在任何一家医院的记录中。

sentences.en: When told to return to their homes and not to worry,
sentences.zh: 当被告知回家等待、不必担心时，

sentences.en: Alma's family couldn't help but feel like the police were treating the situation too casually.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的家人不禁觉得警方处理此事太过草率。

sentences.en: Alma was intelligent, reliable, and well-behaved.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛聪明、可靠且举止端庄。

sentences.en: She wasn't the type to get up to mischief.
sentences.zh: 她不是那种会惹是生非的孩子。

sentences.en: Respecting her elders was a large part of Alma's personality and she'd never intentionally do something to cause others to worry.
sentences.zh: 尊重长辈是阿尔玛性格中很重要的一部分，她绝不会故意做任何让别人担心的事情。

sentences.en: She'd recently returned home early from her school's late-night end-of-year celebrations just to give her grandmother peace of mind.
sentences.zh: 她最近刚从学校的年末晚会提前回家，就是为了让祖母放心。

sentences.en: In the 1920s, Australian children were raised conservatively.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代，澳大利亚的孩子们接受的是保守的教育。

sentences.en: As a result, Alma was incredibly naive and modeSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，阿尔玛非常天真且谦逊。

sentences.en: Menstruation, sex, and other coming-of-age experiences were taboo subjects she knew little about, if anything at all.
sentences.zh: 月经、性以及其他成年礼相关的经历都是禁忌话题，她对此知之甚少，甚至一无所知。

sentences.en: Alma couldn't even bring herself to talk to the boys at her school, let alone strangers.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛甚至不好意思和学校里的男生说话，更不用说陌生人了。

sentences.en: There was no reason to believe that she was disobeying her grandmother to push boundaries.
sentences.zh: 没有任何理由相信她会为了挑战底线而违抗祖母。

sentences.en: Alma lived her life doing for others.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的生活重心就是为他人服务。

sentences.en: In a school essay titled, Duty First, she wrote,
sentences.zh: 在一篇题为《责任至上》的学校作文中，她写道：

sentences.en: A duty embraces a multitude of things.
sentences.zh: “责任涵盖了许多事情。”

sentences.en: This demonstrated Alma's desire to always do what she was told and never leave anyone waiting by deviating from her given task.
sentences.zh: 这表明阿尔玛总是渴望听从教导，绝不会因为偏离既定任务而让任何人等待。

sentences.en: As Elizabeth Tershke described,
sentences.zh: 正如伊丽莎白·特什克所描述的那样：

sentences.en: I had always been very strict with my granddaughter.
sentences.zh: “我对孙女一直要求非常严格。”

sentences.en: We had all taken particular pains to keep her mind free from all sordid and frivolous matters.
sentences.zh: “我们都特别费心，让她的思想远离一切肮脏和轻浮的事物。”

sentences.en: Her disposition was just all sweetness.
sentences.zh: “她的性情非常甜美。”

sentences.en: In her own home, she was happiness itself.
sentences.zh: “在家里，她就是快乐的化身。”

sentences.en: For instance, she might be at a tea party with her aunts and myself and after we had finished the meal, we would miss Alma.
sentences.zh: “例如，她可能和姑妈们还有我在一起喝茶，等我们吃完饭，就会发现阿尔玛不见了。”

sentences.en: On investigating, we would find that she had actually been washing up the dishes by herself.
sentences.zh: “去查看时，我们会发现她其实是在独自洗碗。”

sentences.en: There was no need for any of us, or even for her, to worry.
sentences.zh: “我们任何人，甚至连她自己，都没有理由担心。”

sentences.en: For Alma's family, her unexplained absence meant that something terrible must have happened.
sentences.zh: 对于阿尔玛的家人来说，她莫名失踪意味着一定发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: At the Collins Street flat, Elizabeth waited in the parlour in the hopes her granddaughter would wander in safe and sound.
sentences.zh: 在柯林斯街的公寓里，伊丽莎白坐在客厅里等待，希望孙女能平安归来。

sentences.en: By midnight, four hours had passed since Alma was reported missing.
sentences.zh: 午夜时分，距离阿尔玛失踪报案已经过去了四个小时。

sentences.en: Two police officers soon pushed through the flat's unlocked front door.
sentences.zh: 两名警察推开了公寓未锁的前门。

sentences.en: Elizabeth immediately quizzed them about her granddaughter, but the officers were confused.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白立刻询问孙女的情况，但警察们却感到困惑。

sentences.en: It was part of their job to check premises where lights were on inside and the doors appeared to be unlocked.
sentences.zh: 检查屋内亮着灯且门似乎没锁的场所是他们工作的一部分。

sentences.en: They were just carrying out their regular duties.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在执行常规任务。

sentences.en: Although their patch encompassed the areas relevant to Alma Tershki's disappearance, they hadn't been informed of the matter.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们的辖区涵盖了阿尔玛·特什克失踪的相关区域，但他们并没有接到相关通知。

sentences.en: By the following morning of Saturday December 31, 1921, there still hadn't been any sign of Alma.
sentences.zh: 到了第二天，1921年12月31日星期六，依然没有任何阿尔玛的消息。

sentences.en: As Melbourne stirred in preparation for New Year's Eve,
sentences.zh: 当墨尔本在为除夕夜做准备时，

sentences.en: Henry Errington roamed the streets with his 11-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 亨利·埃林顿带着他11岁的女儿在街上游荡。

sentences.en: The pair were scavenging for glass bottles to cash in for recycling.
sentences.zh: 两人正在搜寻玻璃瓶，以便回收换钱。

sentences.en: They'd already made decent pickings around the city's bustling bar district in the east, having so far filled two sacks.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在东部繁华的酒吧区收获颇丰，装满了两个麻袋。

sentences.en: The duo made their way to the Eastern Market, a flower and retail market between Little Collins and Bourke Streets.
sentences.zh: 两人来到东部市场，这是一个位于小柯林斯街和伯克街之间的花卉和零售市场。

sentences.en: The surrounding streets and laneways consisted of drinkeries, bedding shops and brothels, and at night, the area was a hotbed of wild antics and bad behaviour.
sentences.zh: 周围的街道和小巷里挤满了酒馆、旅店和妓院，到了晚上，这里就是狂野行径和不良行为的温床。

sentences.en: Henry knew there'd be plenty of bottles scattered about the footpaths, gutters and drains in the early morning aftermath.
sentences.zh: 亨利知道，在清晨的余波中，人行道、排水沟和下水道里会散落着许多瓶子。

sentences.en: The father and daughter turned down Little Collins Street, a one-way lane of boutique shops, bars and hotels that ran parallel to the wider Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 这对父女转入小柯林斯街，这是一条与较宽的柯林斯街平行的单行道，两旁是精品店、酒吧和酒店。

sentences.en: Sandwiched between a barbershop and hardware store was a narrow alleyway called Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 在一家理发店和五金店之间，有一条狭窄的小巷，名叫“枪巷”。

sentences.en: A nearby clock tower chimed 6am as Henry made his way into Gun Alley while his young daughter trailed further behind.
sentences.zh: 附近钟楼敲响了早上6点的钟声，亨利走进了枪巷，而他年幼的女儿则落在后面。

sentences.en: It was a secluded space.
sentences.zh: 这是一个僻静的空间。

sentences.en: One side was framed by a two-storey brick wall while a tall, corrugated iron and wood fence flanked the other.
sentences.zh: 一侧是两层高的砖墙，另一侧则是一道高大的波纹铁和木栅栏。

sentences.en: With no source of light, Gun Alley was perpetually dark.
sentences.zh: 由于没有光源，枪巷终年昏暗。

sentences.en: A few metres in, the alley took a sharp turn that led behind the barbershop and reached a dead end.
sentences.zh: 往里走几米，小巷急转弯，通向理发店后面，形成了一条死胡同。

sentences.en: Henry Errington made the turn and paused.
sentences.zh: 亨利·埃林顿转过弯，停住了脚步。

sentences.en: The naked body of Alma Tershki was lying face-up on the brick pavement.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·特什克的裸体遗体仰面躺在砖砌路面上。

sentences.en: Her legs were bent with one on top of the other.
sentences.zh: 她的双腿弯曲，一条压在另一条上。

sentences.en: Bruises covered her right eye, shoulder, thigh, jaw and throat.
sentences.zh: 她的右眼、肩膀、大腿、下巴和喉咙上布满了淤青。

sentences.en: Henry turned and stopped his daughter from witnessing the horrific sight before rushing to a nearby store to phone the police.
sentences.zh: 亨利转过身，阻止女儿看到这恐怖的一幕，然后冲到附近的一家商店打电话报警。

sentences.en: Investigators determined that Alma had sustained a heavy blow to her right eye, but the cause of her death was ruled asphyxiation by manual strangulation.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确定，阿尔玛的右眼受到了重击，但她的死因被判定为手动勒颈导致的窒息。

sentences.en: This implied that her murder was opportunistic as the killer hadn't been prepared with a weapon.
sentences.zh: 这意味着这是一起机会性谋杀，因为凶手并没有准备凶器。

sentences.en: Alma's body showed signs of sexual assault, yet no foreign fluids were detected.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的遗体有性侵迹象，但未检测到外源性体液。

sentences.en: A watery stain running down Alma's thigh indicated that her killer had cleaned her body post-assault.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛大腿上流下的水渍表明，凶手在侵犯后清洗了她的遗体。

sentences.en: It was determined that Alma had been dead for several hours before her body was found.
sentences.zh: 经判定，阿尔玛在遗体被发现前已经死亡数小时。

sentences.en: Gun Alley showed no signs of a struggle, nor was there anything under Alma's fingernails to indicate she'd put up a fight.
sentences.zh: 枪巷没有打斗的迹象，阿尔玛的指甲下也没有任何表明她曾反抗的痕迹。

sentences.en: The killer hadn't left anything behind and Alma's clothing was missing.
sentences.zh: 凶手没有留下任何东西，阿尔玛的衣服也不见了。

sentences.en: Therefore, detectives surmised the bulk of the attack must have occurred elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 因此，侦探们推测袭击的主要过程一定发生在其他地方。

sentences.en: Alma had likely been killed the previous day before being dumped in the alley later that night.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛很可能在前一天就被杀害，之后在当晚被弃尸于巷中。

sentences.en: The area was scoured for clues.
sentences.zh: 警方对该地区进行了地毯式搜查以寻找线索。

sentences.en: Police wondered whether the killer could have tried to force Alma's body down a nearby barrel drain
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑凶手是否曾试图将阿尔玛的遗体塞进附近的桶状排水管中，

sentences.en: and into the wide pipes 12 feet below, as her head was found partially resting on it.
sentences.zh: 并推入12英尺下方的宽大管道，因为她的头部被发现部分搁在上面。

sentences.en: The drains were checked, but nothing of interest was found.
sentences.zh: 排水管经过了检查，但没有发现任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: Even if evidence had been discarded down there, the chances of recovering it now were slim.
sentences.zh: 即使证据被丢弃在那里，现在找回的可能性也很小。

sentences.en: The flowing water would have swept it through the pipes under the city and beyond.
sentences.zh: 流动的积水会将它冲进城市下方的管道并带向远方。

sentences.en: Surrounding bins, shops, residents and rooftops were also checked for clues, but the search came up dry.
sentences.zh: 周围的垃圾桶、商店、住户和屋顶也都被检查过，但搜查一无所获。

sentences.en: Police turned their attention to potential witnesses.
sentences.zh: 警方将注意力转向了潜在的目击者。

sentences.en: A sex worker told them that she'd been in Gun Alley just before 1am.
sentences.zh: 一名性工作者告诉他们，她在凌晨1点前曾去过枪巷。

sentences.en: She didn't see Alma's body or anyone suspicious.
sentences.zh: 她没有看到阿尔玛的遗体，也没有看到任何可疑的人。

sentences.en: As this woman had a reliable reputation with authorities, police determined that Alma's body had been dumped sometime after 1 o'clock.
sentences.zh: 由于该女子在当局那里信誉良好，警方确定阿尔玛的遗体是在1点之后被抛弃的。

sentences.en: Residents who lived above Gun Alley didn't recall hearing a thing.
sentences.zh: 住在枪巷上方的居民不记得听到过任何动静。

sentences.en: Although, even if they had, they wouldn't necessarily have looked outside.
sentences.zh: 不过，即使听到了，他们也不一定会往外看。

sentences.en: Gun Alley was often frequented at night by drunks and drifters, as well as sex workers with their clients.
sentences.zh: 枪巷晚上经常有醉汉、流浪汉以及带着客人的性工作者出没。

sentences.en: It wasn't unusual to hear an assortment of strange noises emanating from down below.
sentences.zh: 听到下方传来各种奇怪的声音并不稀奇。

sentences.en: At around 1am, several residents of Little Collins Street reported hearing what sounded like two gunshots being fired in quick succession.
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点左右，小柯林斯街的几位居民报告说听到了两声连续的枪响。

sentences.en: They quickly realised it was actually the sound of a car backfiring.
sentences.zh: 他们很快意识到那其实是汽车回火的声音。

sentences.en: They also heard a door being slammed shut.
sentences.zh: 他们还听到了关门声。

sentences.en: This supported the theory that the killer had transported Alma's body to Gun Alley under the cover of darkness.
sentences.zh: 这支持了凶手在夜幕掩护下将阿尔玛的遗体运送到枪巷的理论。

sentences.en: But the question remained, where had she been taken first?
sentences.zh: 但问题依然存在，她最初被带到了哪里？

sentences.en: The killer needed privacy and time to not only assault Alma, but clean her body too.
sentences.zh: 凶手需要隐私和时间，不仅要侵犯阿尔玛，还要清洗她的遗体。

sentences.en: Investigators therefore believed he must have taken her somewhere familiar, where he didn't run the risk of being caught in the act.
sentences.zh: 因此，调查人员认为他一定把她带到了某个熟悉的地方，在那里他不会冒被当场抓获的风险。

sentences.en: For that reason, shared housing seemed unlikely.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，合租的可能性似乎不大。

sentences.en: Local hotels and lodgings were checked and ruled out.
sentences.zh: 当地的旅馆和住宿点都经过了排查，被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: It was also possible that the killer lived with his family, but had time alone while they went away for the holiday period.
sentences.zh: 还有一种可能，凶手与家人同住，但趁家人假期外出时有了独处的时间。

sentences.en: Yet, Alma was manually strangled.
sentences.zh: 然而，阿尔玛是被人徒手勒死的。

sentences.en: This was common in attacks where the killer felt pressured to silence their victim.
sentences.zh: 在凶手感到必须让受害者噤声的袭击中，这种手段很常见。

sentences.en: After killing Alma, common sense dictated that the perpetrator wouldn't have wanted to transport her body very far.
sentences.zh: 杀害阿尔玛后，按常理推断，凶手不会想把尸体运到太远的地方。

sentences.en: The surrounding city streets were never completely deserted, no matter the hour.
sentences.zh: 无论什么时间，城市周边的街道从不会完全空无一人。

sentences.en: It was possible that he'd carried Alma's body in a bag or in some other inconspicuous way, yet no one had seen a man lugging anything hefty.
sentences.zh: 凶手有可能用袋子或其他不显眼的方式运送了阿尔玛的尸体，但没人看到有男人扛着沉重的东西。

sentences.en: The city's alcohol-fuelled nightlife might have allowed him to trek along busy thoroughfares completely unnoticed,
sentences.zh: 城市里酒精弥漫的夜生活可能让他得以在繁忙的街道上穿行而不被察觉，

sentences.en: while the darkened streets, alleys and doorways would have provided him with plenty of hiding spots.
sentences.zh: 而昏暗的街道、小巷和门口则为他提供了充足的藏身之处。

sentences.en: Dumping Alma's body was no doubt a strategic move to prevent investigators from having a crime scene to examine.
sentences.zh: 抛弃阿尔玛的尸体无疑是一种战略举措，目的是让调查人员没有犯罪现场可供检查。

sentences.en: Still, they weren't sure what to make of this scenario.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们仍不确定该如何看待这种假设。

sentences.en: If the killer had access to a car, why didn't he leave Alma's body somewhere it wouldn't be found?
sentences.zh: 如果凶手有车，为什么不把阿尔玛的尸体留在某个不容易被发现的地方呢？

sentences.en: Alma's body was left at the end of Gun Alley after it turned 90 degrees and was no longer visible from the street.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的尸体被丢弃在枪巷（Gun Alley）的尽头，那里拐了一个90度的弯，从街上已经看不见了。

sentences.en: Unless one had travelled down the alley before, there was no way of knowing it featured this distinctive turn or reached a dead end.
sentences.zh: 除非以前走过这条巷子，否则根本无法知道它有这样一个独特的转弯，也无法知道它是一条死胡同。

sentences.en: If the killer lived nearby or frequented the area often, he'd know which spots were populated, which were lit, and possibly, the route and timings of police on the beat.
sentences.zh: 如果凶手住在附近或经常出入该地区，他就会知道哪些地方人多、哪些地方有灯光，甚至可能知道警察巡逻的路线和时间。

sentences.en: Officers tasked with safeguarding this particular area of Melbourne had a set routine.
sentences.zh: 负责守卫墨尔本这一特定区域的警员有一套固定的作息。

sentences.en: Between 1 and 2am, they headed to the nearby town hall police depot for a meal and a drink before going back out.
sentences.zh: 凌晨1点到2点之间，他们会前往附近的市政厅警察局吃点东西、喝杯水，然后再出去巡逻。

sentences.en: The killer's movement seemed incredibly well-timed to fit this gap.
sentences.zh: 凶手的行动时间似乎掐得非常准，正好卡在这个空档。

sentences.en: The officer on the beat that night was required to check every lane and alley on the block.
sentences.zh: 当晚值班的警员被要求检查街区内的每一条巷子。

sentences.en: Less than an hour after the sex worker left a gun alley, the officer reached the top of the alley and peered into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 在那名性工作者离开枪巷不到一小时后，警员到达了巷口，向黑暗中望去。

sentences.en: Not noticing anything odd, he continued on his route.
sentences.zh: 没发现什么异常，他便继续沿路线巡逻。

sentences.en: Had he performed his duties properly and gone into the alley, he might have come across Alma's body and possibly her killer.
sentences.zh: 如果他尽职尽责地走进巷子里，或许就能发现阿尔玛的尸体，甚至可能撞见凶手。

sentences.en: Even if the killer had already fled, it was likely he'd still been in the vicinity and there would have been a greater chance of him being caught.
sentences.zh: 即使凶手已经逃离，他也可能还在附近，这样被抓获的几率会大得多。

sentences.en: With her long golden red hair, freckled face and school uniform,
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·特什基（Alma Tershki）留着一头金红色的长发，长着一张满是雀斑的脸，穿着校服，

sentences.en: Alma Tershki cut a memorable figure and several witnesses recalled seeing her on the afternoon of her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 外貌令人印象深刻，几位目击者都记得在失踪那天下午见过她。

sentences.en: After picking up the parcel from her uncle's butcher, Alma was seen walking in the direction of her aunt's flat on Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 从叔叔的肉铺取回包裹后，有人看到阿尔玛朝着她姑妈在柯林斯街（Collins Street）的公寓走去。

sentences.en: Unlike the exclusive and opulent precinct that it is today, in the 1920s, the Collins Street area was regarded as a disreputable part of Melbourne.
sentences.zh: 与今天的高档繁华不同，在20世纪20年代，柯林斯街一带被认为是墨尔本名声不佳的地区。

sentences.en: In the words of the Herald newspaper, its atmosphere was squalid and depressing.
sentences.zh: 用《先驱报》（Herald）的话说，那里的环境肮脏而压抑。

sentences.en: The streets were lined with decrepit, dated buildings crammed between cheap and gloomy lodging houses.
sentences.zh: 街道两旁尽是破旧过时的建筑，挤在廉价而阴暗的旅馆之间。

sentences.en: A witness saw Alma slowly turn up Little Collins Street, looking up at the buildings as if she was loSt.
sentences.zh: 一位目击者看到阿尔玛慢慢拐进小柯林斯街（Little Collins Street），抬头看着建筑，好像迷路了。

sentences.en: Had she continued up Little Collins Street and taken a left, she would have reached her destination.
sentences.zh: 如果她继续沿小柯林斯街走并向左转，就能到达目的地。

sentences.en: However, at 2.30, someone else spotted her on Bourke Street.
sentences.zh: 然而，两点半时，有人在伯克街（Bourke Street）看到了她。

sentences.en: This meant she'd taken a right.
sentences.zh: 这意味着她向右转了。

sentences.en: A mother and daughter incidentally trailed Alma for a short distance until she entered the Eastern Arcade,
sentences.zh: 一对母女无意中跟了阿尔玛一小段路，直到她进入东方拱廊（Eastern Arcade），

sentences.en: a two-level building next to the Eastern Market, across the road from Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 这是一座位于东方市场（Eastern Market）隔壁的两层建筑，就在枪巷马路对面。

sentences.en: The Arcade served as a thoroughfare from Bourke to Little Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 该拱廊是通往伯克街到小柯林斯街的通道。

sentences.en: Its long, narrow, enclosed court interior was mostly desolate.
sentences.zh: 其狭长封闭的内部庭院大多荒凉冷清。

sentences.en: Many of the shops within were empty, save for 50 or so businesses between both floors, including a tobacconist, a herbalist, and second-hand dealers.
sentences.zh: 里面的许多店铺都是空的，两层楼加起来只有50家左右的商户，包括烟草商、草药商和二手经销商。

sentences.en: Drab, dark, and dusty, the building reeked of mustiness.
sentences.zh: 建筑昏暗、阴沉、布满灰尘，散发着一股霉味。

sentences.en: Neglected grime had crusted over the ornate glass-domed roof, preventing sunlight from pouring in, and cobwebs dangled from all corners and crevices.
sentences.zh: 被忽视的污垢结在了华丽的玻璃穹顶上，挡住了阳光，角落和缝隙里挂满了蜘蛛网。

sentences.en: The Arcade's inhabitants were rough.
sentences.zh: 拱廊里的住户都是些粗野之徒。

sentences.en: Most were on the fringe of society and or living in poverty, but there were other unconventional characters like fortune-tellers and mediuMs.
sentences.zh: 大多数人处于社会边缘或生活贫困，但也有一些非传统的人物，比如算命师和灵媒。

sentences.en: As The Age described,
sentences.zh: 正如《时代报》（The Age）所描述的那样：

sentences.en: From the early days of Melbourne, this section of the city has been the haunt of thieves and gamblers and other people of low type, a haven for evil characters.
sentences.zh: 从墨尔本早期开始，这一区域就是小偷、赌徒和其他低等人的出没地，是邪恶之徒的避风港。

sentences.en: Most of the Arcade's regulars were suspicious of police and reluctant to speak with them.
sentences.zh: 拱廊里的常客大多对警察心存疑虑，不愿与他们交谈。

sentences.en: There was no known reason for Alma to enter the Eastern Arcade.
sentences.zh: 没有已知的理由让阿尔玛进入东方拱廊。

sentences.en: Alma's grandmother suggested she might have gone in to use the public restroom.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的祖母认为她可能是进去使用公共洗手间。

sentences.en: Whatever the case, it was unlikely Alma was aware of the Arcade's seedy reputation.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，阿尔玛不太可能知道拱廊那糟糕的名声。

sentences.en: Towards the Little Collins Street exit of the Eastern Arcade was a bar called the Australian Wine Saloon.
sentences.zh: 在东方拱廊靠近小柯林斯街的出口处，有一家名为“澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙”（Australian Wine Saloon）的酒吧。

sentences.en: It too drew in a bad crowd.
sentences.zh: 它也吸引了不三不四的人群。

sentences.en: Anyone was served there, regardless of age.
sentences.zh: 那里对任何人提供服务，不分年龄。

sentences.en: Customers were often spotted around Little Collins Street at all hours in varying states of intoxication, vomiting, urinating, and confronting passers-by.
sentences.zh: 人们经常看到顾客在小柯林斯街附近，处于不同程度的醉酒状态，呕吐、随地小便并挑衅路人。

sentences.en: The Australian Wine Saloon was owned and operated by a man named Colin Ross.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙由一个叫科林·罗斯（Colin Ross）的男人拥有和经营。

sentences.en: Shortly before 3pm on Friday December 30,
sentences.zh: 12月30日星期五下午3点前不久，

sentences.en: Colin briefly stepped out of his saloon and happened to see Alma Tershke.
sentences.zh: 科林短暂地走出沙龙，碰巧看到了阿尔玛·特什基。

sentences.en: She paced around as if looking for somebody, before exiting the Arcade.
sentences.zh: 她在那里踱步，好像在找人，随后离开了拱廊。

sentences.en: The next sighting of Alma was as she crossed Little Collins Street just a few hundred metres from where she'd started her journey.
sentences.zh: 下一次有人看到阿尔玛时，她正穿过小柯林斯街，距离她开始行程的地方仅几百米。

sentences.en: It had taken her 90 minutes to walk in a circle around a city block.
sentences.zh: 她花了90分钟绕着一个街区走了一圈。

sentences.en: Even more troubling, when witnesses described Alma's demeanour, they used words like nervous, agitated, and even frightened.
sentences.zh: 更令人不安的是，当目击者描述阿尔玛的神态时，他们用了“紧张”、“焦躁”甚至“惊恐”这样的词。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: Casefile节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商，以此支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也在支持Casefile继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: Alma's journey would have taken her past some slum dwellings on Little Collins Street.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的行程本应经过小柯林斯街上的一些贫民窟住宅。

sentences.en: Investigators considered whether an unscrupulous loiterer had lured her away, or maybe she'd been stalked by a predator who pounced at an opportunistic moment.
sentences.zh: 调查人员考虑过是否有一个不怀好意的游荡者引诱她离开，或者她是否被一个伺机而动的掠食者跟踪了。

sentences.en: Given Alma's unsettled state, she might have known she was being followed and had been wandering around trying to give her pursuer the slip.
sentences.zh: 考虑到阿尔玛不安的状态，她可能知道自己被跟踪了，一直在四处游荡，试图甩掉跟踪者。

sentences.en: Alma was obedient and introverted in nature, with a soft way of speaking.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛性格顺从内向，说话轻声细语。

sentences.en: If something were amiss, she didn't have the tenacity to confront the problem head on.
sentences.zh: 如果出了什么问题，她没有直面解决问题的韧性。

sentences.en: In the words of her uncle, John,
sentences.zh: 用她叔叔约翰的话说：

sentences.en: Though of a bright disposition,
sentences.zh: 虽然性格开朗，

sentences.en: Alma was somewhat reserved and did not make friends readily like some girls.
sentences.zh: 但阿尔玛有些内向，不像有些女孩那样容易交朋友。

sentences.en: She lacked the vivacious manner that encourages a chance acquaintance.
sentences.zh: 她缺乏那种能促进偶然结识的活泼气质。

sentences.en: By the time Alma's body was discovered, her killer had a sizable head start.
sentences.zh: 当阿尔玛的尸体被发现时，凶手已经领先了相当长的时间。

sentences.en: Despite the lack of clues or evidence, investigators were certain the mystery would be solved within days.
sentences.zh: 尽管缺乏线索或证据，调查人员仍确信这起悬案会在几天内告破。

sentences.en: The Victorian government offered a £250 reward for information that led to a conviction, an amount that was deemed woefully inadequate by the local populace.
sentences.zh: 维多利亚州政府悬赏250英镑征集破案线索，当地民众认为这个金额少得可怜。

sentences.en: Given the urgency of this situation, they expected a far higher and more tempting offer.
sentences.zh: 鉴于情况紧急，他们期待着一份更高、更具诱惑力的悬赏。

sentences.en: If the investigation took too long, the killer could flee the state, or worse, strike again.
sentences.zh: 如果调查耗时太长，凶手可能会逃离本州，或者更糟，再次作案。

sentences.en: But by Tuesday, January 3, 1922, four days after Alma's body was discovered, there still hadn't been any arrests.
sentences.zh: 但到了1922年1月3日星期二，即阿尔玛尸体被发现四天后，依然没有任何人被捕。

sentences.en: Alma Tershke was laid to rest that day.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·特什基在那天入土为安。

sentences.en: Her small coffin was adorned with white flowers, with six of her friends acting as pallbearers.
sentences.zh: 她的小棺材上装饰着白花，由她的六个朋友担任护柩者。

sentences.en: Alma's grieving family travelled with her body in the hearse that took her to her final resting place, a plot alongside her recently deceased grandfather at Brighton Cemetery.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛悲痛欲绝的家人随灵车护送她的遗体前往最终安息地——布莱顿公墓（Brighton Cemetery），那里安葬着她刚去世不久的祖父。

sentences.en: After Alma's funeral, her loved ones went to Gun Alley for a moment of private reflection.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的葬礼结束后，她的亲人们前往枪巷进行片刻的私人悼念。

sentences.en: They were confronted by a large crowd of strangers gawking at the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 他们面对的是一大群围观犯罪现场的陌生人。

sentences.en: Gun Alley had been chaotic since the discovery of Alma's body, a non-stop influx of locals, out-of-towners, police, and news reporters flooded the small area at all hours.
sentences.zh: 自发现阿尔玛尸体以来，枪巷一直处于混乱之中，当地人、外地人、警察和新闻记者不分昼夜地涌入这个狭小的区域。

sentences.en: Within the first week of January 1922, thousands of people pushed their way through the tight space to observe the area, lay flowers, condemn the perpetrator, and swap theories.
sentences.zh: 1922年1月的第一周内，成千上万的人挤进狭窄的空间，观察现场、献花、谴责凶手并交流各种理论。

sentences.en: A line of people nearly 100 metres long stretched from the alley's entrance, with inconvenienced business owners threatening to hose the onlookers if they didn't disperse.
sentences.zh: 从巷口延伸出近100米长的队伍，受影响的店主威胁说，如果围观者不散去，就用水管冲他们。

sentences.en: Similar crowds also descended on the Eastern Arcade, storming into shops and lodgings, shouting,
sentences.zh: 类似的人群也涌向东方拱廊，冲进商店和旅馆，大喊着：

sentences.en: Let us at them!
sentences.zh: 让我们进去！

sentences.en: Pull the place down!
sentences.zh: 把这地方拆了！

sentences.en: Alma Tershki's murder was the first crime in Melbourne to create such hysteria.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛·特什基的谋杀案是墨尔本第一起引发如此歇斯底里情绪的犯罪。

sentences.en: The press covered the story exhaustively, releasing detailed updates about the investigation every morning and afternoon that included evidence uncovered and witness accounts.
sentences.zh: 媒体对该案进行了详尽报道，每天早晚发布关于调查的详细更新，包括新发现的证据和目击者证词。

sentences.en: The people of Australia were left reeling.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚民众感到震惊。

sentences.en: How did a killer strike in broad daylight on the bustling streets of Melbourne's theatre district?
sentences.zh: 一个凶手怎么能在墨尔本剧院区繁忙的街道上光天化日之下行凶？

sentences.en: Mothers used Alma's death as a warning to their own children, even though no one fully knew what she'd experienced or by whom.
sentences.zh: 母亲们用阿尔玛的死来警告自己的孩子，尽管没人完全知道她经历了什么，也不知道凶手是谁。

sentences.en: The one thing people did know was that her killer was a cold-blooded, careful predator.
sentences.zh: 人们唯一知道的是，凶手是一个冷血、谨慎的掠食者。

sentences.en: As fear gripped the city, members of Melbourne's criminal underworld offered their help by sending the message to the police.
sentences.zh: 随着恐惧笼罩全城，墨尔本犯罪黑社会成员也向警方传话，表示愿意提供帮助。

sentences.en: You tell us who you want and we'll get him for you.
sentences.zh: 你们告诉我们要抓谁，我们会把他给你们抓来。

sentences.en: An article in the Age newspaper asserted,
sentences.zh: 《时代报》的一篇文章断言：

sentences.en: The circumstances of the case are of such a tragic and revolting character that the whole community should leave no stone unturned to discover the criminal.
sentences.zh: 案件的情况如此悲惨和令人作呕，整个社会都应竭尽全力找出罪犯。

sentences.en: The issue for police wasn't that they weren't getting enough tips, it's that they were getting too many.
sentences.zh: 警方的问题不在于收到的线索不够，而在于线索太多了。

sentences.en: Melbourne's citizens reported all sorts of suspicious behaviour, including a man who changed his outfit three times in one day.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本市民报告了各种可疑行为，包括一个一天换了三次衣服的男人。

sentences.en: Police were spoken to about everything, from worrisome dreams to clairvoyant visions.
sentences.zh: 从令人担忧的梦境到通灵的幻象，警方什么都听。

sentences.en: The constant pile-on ran the risk of key information being overlooked.
sentences.zh: 不断的干扰导致关键信息被忽略的风险增加。

sentences.en: Even though the crime scene had been thoroughly examined and cleared by authorities, amateur sleuths muddied the waters by inundating Gun Alley and handing over
sentences.zh: 尽管犯罪现场已被当局彻底检查和清理，但业余侦探们通过涌入枪巷并上交

sentences.en: anything they came across, from buttons to a piece of ribbon.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的任何东西（从纽扣到丝带碎片）搅浑了水。

sentences.en: One man even handed over a parcel of sausages he found behind a drainpipe, thinking it could have been the meat our Matershki had collected from the butcher prior to her murder.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一个人上交了一包他在排水管后面发现的香肠，认为这可能是阿尔玛在谋杀前从肉铺取回的肉。

sentences.en: In actuality, all of these items had been strewn there by hoaxsters wanting to stir up some drama.
sentences.zh: 实际上，所有这些物品都是想制造轰动的恶作剧者扔在那里的。

sentences.en: Detectives also began receiving anonymous death threats warning them to drop the inquiry.
sentences.zh: 侦探们还开始收到匿名的死亡威胁，警告他们停止调查。

sentences.en: These too were suspected to be from pranksters.
sentences.zh: 这些也被怀疑是恶作剧者所为。

sentences.en: Despite the chaos, the police encouraged the community to keep information pouring in.
sentences.zh: 尽管混乱不堪，警方还是鼓励社区继续提供信息。

sentences.en: On Thursday,
sentences.zh: 周四，

sentences.zh: 1月5日，一位住在小柯林斯街附近的居民打来电话，声称有与案件相关的重要信息。

sentences.en: Several detectives piled into a police car and sped towards the destination.
sentences.zh: 几名侦探挤进一辆警车，飞速驶向目的地。

sentences.en: As they approached the corner of Lonsdale and Exhibition Streets, a man staggered in front of their car.
sentences.zh: 当他们接近朗斯代尔街（Lonsdale Street）和展览街（Exhibition Street）的拐角处时，一个男人摇摇晃晃地冲到了车前。

sentences.en: The driver swerved to avoid them, causing the vehicle's front wheels to lock and skid.
sentences.zh: 司机猛打方向盘避让，导致车辆前轮锁死并打滑。

sentences.en: The car overturned, throwing two officers from their seats and leaving a third pinned underneath.
sentences.zh: 汽车翻倒，两名警员被甩出座位，第三名警员被压在车下。

sentences.en: The officers only sustained broken bones and relatively minor injuries, but the entire fiasco was reported by the press, who had been casting

sentences.en: The police car involved in the crash was an old, obsolete vehicle that had earned the nickname among officers as the Suicide Car due to its poor and dangerous state.
sentences.zh: 涉事警车是一辆陈旧过时的车辆，因其糟糕且危险的状态，在警员中被称为“自杀车”。

sentences.zh: 负责在案发当晚检查枪巷的警员也是如此。

sentences.en: If he'd had better resources, some questioned how things could have worked out differently.
sentences.zh: 有人质疑，如果他有更好的资源，事情会不会有不同的结果。

sentences.en: Then there was the matter of the police photographer who shared his services across all government departments.
sentences.zh: 还有负责为所有政府部门提供服务的警察摄影师的问题。

sentences.en: This meant no photographs had been taken of her body in situ or in the mortuary.
sentences.zh: 这意味着没有拍摄到她尸体在现场或停尸房的照片。

sentences.en: At the time, it was the sole duty of detectives to examine and interpret a crime scene.
sentences.zh: 当时，检查和解读犯罪现场是侦探的唯一职责。

sentences.en: Even though forensic sciences were not entirely new, few in Victoria were trained in its most recent developments.
sentences.zh: 尽管法医学并不完全是新事物，但维多利亚州很少有人受过最新发展的培训。

sentences.en: Not only did the police lack the expertise they needed, they also lacked manpower.
sentences.zh: 警方不仅缺乏所需的专业知识，还缺乏人力。

sentences.en: When Alma's body was first discovered, only three officers were dispatched to Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的尸体刚被发现时，只有三名警员被派往枪巷。

sentences.en: This was barely enough to maintain the integrity of the crime scene, let alone close off the surrounding area to search for the killer.
sentences.zh: 这勉强够维持犯罪现场的完整性，更不用说封锁周边区域搜捕凶手了。

sentences.en: Curious onlookers and news reporters had trudged their way through the alley before it could be cordoned off and guarded.
sentences.zh: 好奇的围观者和新闻记者在现场被封锁和守卫之前，就已经践踏过巷子了。

sentences.en: With the limited resources they had, it took the police days to properly examine the crime scene, not to mention the greater area.
sentences.zh: 由于资源有限，警方花了几天时间才对犯罪现场进行了妥善检查，更不用说更大的区域了。

sentences.en: As Victoria Police faced growing criticism, the government upped the reward in Alma's case to 1,000 pounds.
sentences.zh: 随着维多利亚州警方面临越来越多的批评，政府将阿尔玛案的悬赏金提高到了1000英镑。

sentences.en: This was one of the biggest rewards ever offered in Australian history, enough to buy several houses and live a comfortable life.
sentences.zh: 这是澳大利亚历史上提供的最高悬赏之一，足以买下几栋房子并过上舒适的生活。

sentences.en: The increase was well received by the community.
sentences.zh: 这一增长受到了社区的欢迎。

sentences.en: It served as both a face-saving strategy for the government and a timely distraction of the underlying issues that plagued the police.
sentences.zh: 它既是政府挽回面子的策略，也是对困扰警方潜在问题的及时转移注意力。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the relationship between the police and the press remained rocky.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方与媒体之间的关系依然紧张。

sentences.en: Within days of Alma's murder, they'd portrayed the police as having failed ingloriously for not making any arrests.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔玛遇害后的几天内，媒体就将警方描绘成因未能逮捕任何人而蒙羞。

sentences.en: They started demanding a royal commission into the police's incompetence, and the public had little confidence in law enforcement as a result.
sentences.zh: 他们开始要求成立皇家委员会调查警方的无能，结果公众对执法部门几乎失去了信心。

sentences.en: The pressure on detectives to solve the case quickly was immense.
sentences.zh: 侦探们面临着迅速破案的巨大压力。

sentences.en: One detective told the press,
sentences.zh: 一位侦探告诉媒体：

sentences.en: Any day now we expect to get our man.
sentences.zh: 我们随时都可能抓到凶手。

sentences.en: The editor of the Argus newspaper doubted this, writing, As each day passes, the grievous disappointment of the public at the failure of the police to track down the murderer
sentences.zh: 《阿格斯报》的编辑对此表示怀疑，他写道：随着日子一天天过去，公众对警方未能追踪到阿尔玛·特什基的凶手所感到的沉重失望

sentences.en: of Alma Tershki grows more profound.
sentences.zh: 变得愈发深重。

sentences.zh: 墨尔本的侦探和警察部队正面临考验，无论他们觉得这种磨难多么苛刻，他们都必须意识到公众不会容忍

sentences.zh: 看到阿尔玛进入东拱廊的那对母女证实了科林的说法。

sentences.en: They not only saw Alma, but also remember seeing Colin Ross as he stepped outside of his establishment to observe the Arcade.
sentences.zh: 她们不仅看到了阿尔玛，还记得看到科林·罗斯走出他的店面观察拱廊。

sentences.en: When they glanced back, both Alma and Colin were gone.
sentences.zh: 当她们回头看时，阿尔玛和科林都不见了。

sentences.zh: 澳大利亚葡萄酒沙龙占据了拱廊底层的两个店面。

sentences.zh: 科林迅速将艾薇带到外面，来到

sentences.zh: 他承认当时他正站在沙龙外，阿尔玛走过来向他要酒喝。

sentences.zh: 他说他把她带进屋里，领进了后屋。

sentences.en: Colin assured Ivy that he didn't do anything to Alma, but implied that she'd been with men before.
sentences.zh: 科林向艾薇保证他没有对阿尔玛做什么，但暗示她以前就和男人在一起过。

sentences.en: He said he'd intended to move her on when his bar closed, but she wouldn't leave.
sentences.zh: 他说他本打算在酒吧关门时让她离开，但她不肯走。

sentences.en: But Colin soon changed his tune.
sentences.zh: 但科林很快改变了说法。

sentences.en: He allegedly broke down, telling Ivy that he suffered from a disease where being in the presence of a child caused him to lose his head.
sentences.zh: 据称他崩溃了，告诉艾薇他患有一种疾病，在孩子面前会失去理智。

sentences.en: He confessed that he'd, quote, ravished Alma, and that without meaning to, she was dead before he knew it.
sentences.zh: 他承认他，引用他的话，“蹂躏”了阿尔玛，而且在不知不觉中，她在他意识到之前就已经死了。

sentences.en: Afterwards, he wrapped Alma's body in the blankets from the back room and went home.
sentences.zh: 事后，他用后屋的毯子裹住阿尔玛的尸体，然后回家了。

sentences.en: He drove back to the saloon in the early hours of the morning and used his car to move Alma's body to Gun Alley.
sentences.zh: 他在凌晨时分开车回到沙龙，用他的车把阿尔玛的尸体运到了枪巷。

sentences.en: As Colin told Ivy this, he was visibly distraught.
sentences.zh: 当科林告诉艾薇这些时，他显得非常痛苦。

sentences.en: According to Ivy, he said that after killing Alma, he'd felt like getting a knife and finishing himself.
sentences.zh: 据艾薇说，他说在杀了阿尔玛之后，他曾想拿把刀自杀。

sentences.zh: 他称这些是蓄意撒谎，并说：你们什么也查不到。

sentences.zh: 尽管如此，科林·罗斯还是被控谋杀阿尔玛·特什基。

sentences.en: As he was led away for processing, his relaxed attitude faltered and he began yelling about a frame-up.
sentences.zh: 当他被带走接受处理时，他那放松的态度消失了，开始大喊这是陷害。

sentences.en: His mother and brothers accepted his assertions of innocence and contacted a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲和兄弟们相信他是清白的，并联系了一名律师。

sentences.en: Colin was scheduled to appear in court the next day.
sentences.zh: 科林定于第二天出庭。

sentences.en: By then, news of his arrest had made headlines, making him the most hated man in Australia.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他被捕的消息已登上头条，使他成为澳大利亚最受憎恨的人。

sentences.en: A large angry crowd amassed at the city court calling for Colin's head as the police tried in vain to disperse them.
sentences.zh: 一大群愤怒的人群聚集在市法院，要求严惩科林，警察试图驱散他们，但无济于事。

sentences.en: Colin was transported into the building via a direct passage from the police station cells to bypass the raging mob.
sentences.zh: 科林通过警察局牢房的直接通道被送入大楼，以避开暴怒的暴徒。

sentences.en: Colin appeared optimistic about his situation, though wept after briefly speaking with his mother.
sentences.zh: 科林对自己的处境似乎很乐观，但在与母亲短暂交谈后流下了眼泪。

sentences.en: His nerves kicked in once he was in front of the judges.
sentences.zh: 当他站在法官面前时，他开始感到紧张。

sentences.en: Detective Fred Piggott detailed the case against the accused.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·皮戈特侦探详细陈述了针对被告的案件。

sentences.en: A coronial inquest into Alma Tershki's death was scheduled to determine if Colin Ross would stand trial for her murder.
sentences.zh: 针对阿尔玛·特什基死因的验尸官调查已排上日程，以决定科林·罗斯是否会因谋杀罪受审。

sentences.en: He objected to being remanded in custody until then, telling the court that he'd prefer to be out so witnesses could come to him and prove his
sentences.zh: 他反对在此期间被还押候审，告诉法庭他宁愿在外面，这样证人可以来找他，证明他

sentences.en: Colin pleaded,
sentences.zh: 科林恳求道：

sentences.zh: 话音刚落，他的母亲伊迪突然从公众席站起来宣布：我可以证明他在哪里。

sentences.en: One of Edie's sons quietened her and pulled her back down to her seat.
sentences.zh: 伊迪的一个儿子让她安静下来，并把她拉回座位上。

sentences.zh: 他试图与她搭话，但她没理他。

sentences.zh: 确信没人看到他们后，

sentences.en: She refused at first, but Colin eventually persuaded her to take a sip.
sentences.zh: 她起初拒绝了，但科林最终说服她喝了一口。

sentences.en: The two proceeded to talk for several hours, during which Alma consumed two more glasses of wine.

sentences.zh: 科林离开去和另一位酒吧常客交谈。

sentences.zh: 关门后，他回到后屋，发现阿尔玛已经睡着了。

sentences.zh: 据称科林告诉西德尼·哈丁，他无法抵御诱惑。

sentences.zh: 他开始猥亵阿尔玛，期间她惊醒并大声呼救。

sentences.en: At some point during the attack,

sentences.en: He rushed back and tried to pacify her, but she wouldn't settle.
sentences.zh: 他冲回去试图安抚她，但她无法平静下来。

sentences.en: Not knowing what came over him, he began choking her.
sentences.zh: 不知道自己怎么了，他开始掐她的脖子。

sentences.en: Colin allegedly told Sidney that when he came back to his senses, he lifted Alma's arm and it flopped lifelessly, confirming she was dead.
sentences.zh: 据称科林告诉西德尼，当他回过神来时，他抬起阿尔玛的手臂，手臂无力地垂下，证实她已经死了。

sentences.en: He calmed down and tried to think.
sentences.zh: 他冷静下来，试图思考对策。

sentences.en: Alma looked horrible and it was bleeding badly.
sentences.zh: 阿尔玛的样子很可怕，而且流了很多血。

sentences.en: Colin grabbed a bucket full of water and cleaned her body, then the scene.
sentences.zh: 科林抓起一桶水，清理了她的尸体，然后清理了现场。

sentences.en: He had plans to meet his friend Gladys at 9pm and he knew it'd be suspicious if he cancelled.
sentences.zh: 他计划在晚上9点见他的朋友格拉迪斯，他知道如果取消会很可疑。

sentences.en: He took Gladys to the saloon, where she remained blissfully unaware that a child's body lay hidden just metres away.
sentences.zh: 他把格拉迪斯带到沙龙，她完全不知道几米外就藏着一具孩子的尸体。

sentences.en: According to Sidney,
sentences.zh: 据西德尼说，

sentences.en: Colin said he then walked Gladys home and caught public transport back to his place in Footscray.
sentences.zh: 科林说他随后送格拉迪斯回家，并乘坐公共交通工具回到了他在富茨克雷的住处。

sentences.en: Along the way, he made himself as conspicuous as possible to establish as many alibis as he could.
sentences.zh: 一路上，他尽可能引人注目，以便制造尽可能多的不在场证明。

sentences.en: In the early morning hours,
sentences.zh: 凌晨时分，

sentences.en: Colin stole a bicycle from a neighbouring home and rode the 10km back to the Eastern Arcade.
sentences.zh: 科林从邻居家偷了一辆自行车，骑了10公里回到东部拱廊。

sentences.zh: 在绕着大楼走了一圈确认安全后，他进了沙龙。

sentences.en: He stripped Alma's body naked and wrapped it in a coat before carrying her body across the road to Gun Alley and leaving it there.
sentences.zh: 他剥光了阿尔玛的尸体，用一件外套裹住，然后把尸体搬过马路到枪巷，并留在了那里。

sentences.en: On his way home,
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，

sentences.zh: 科林在富茨克雷路停下来，把阿尔玛的衣服撕成条状。

sentences.en: He scattered the pieces as he rode onwards, throwing each of her shoes into two nearby rivers.
sentences.zh: 他一边骑车一边散落这些碎片，并将她的两只鞋分别扔进附近的河流中。

sentences.en: After returning the bicycle to his neighbour's house, he went home.
sentences.zh: 把自行车还回邻居家后，他回家了。

sentences.en: Colin allegedly told Sidney that the only other person he'd told this to was his lawyer, who'd advised him to keep his mouth shut.
sentences.zh: 据称科林告诉西德尼，他唯一告诉过这件事的人是他的律师，律师建议他闭嘴。

sentences.en: He said he trusted Sidney and felt good about his case.
sentences.zh: 他说他信任西德尼，对自己的案子感觉良好。

sentences.en: Once it was all over, he intended to sue for compensation.
sentences.zh: 一旦这一切结束，他打算起诉索赔。

sentences.en: Unless he lost, in which case, he'd take his own life.
sentences.zh: 除非他输了，那样的话，他就自杀。

sentences.en: The inquest into the death of Alma Tershki took place on Wednesday,
sentences.zh: 对阿尔玛·特什基死因的调查于星期三进行，

sentences.en: January 25, a little under a month after she was killed.
sentences.zh: 1月25日，距离她遇害不到一个月。

sentences.en: An angry mob encircled the building, forming the largest crowd the court had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的暴徒包围了大楼，形成了法院有史以来见过的最大人群。

sentences.en: This time, the police came prepared.
sentences.zh: 这一次，警察做好了准备。

sentences.en: They kept the peace as detectives, witnesses, and members of Colin Ross's family were hurried inside, followed by the shackled man himself.
sentences.zh: 当侦探、证人和科林·罗斯的家属被匆忙带入大楼，随后是戴着镣铐的科林本人时，他们维持了秩序。

sentences.en: Each of the case's witnesses took the stand to reiterate what they'd seen or heard.
sentences.zh: 案件的每位证人都走上证人席，重申他们所见或所闻。

sentences.en: Colin stared unflinchingly as Ivy Matthews and Sidney Harding detailed the alleged confessions he'd made to them.
sentences.zh: 当艾薇·马修斯和西德尼·哈丁详细陈述他据称对他们所做的供述时，科林面不改色地盯着他们。

sentences.en: Every so often, his lips would curl into a smile.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，他的嘴角就会露出一丝微笑。

sentences.en: After hearing testimony from witnesses, case detectives, and the forensic analyst,
sentences.zh: 在听取了证人、案件侦探和法医分析师的证词后，

sentences.en: Colin refused the opportunity to take the stand.
sentences.zh: 科林拒绝了出庭作证的机会。

sentences.zh: 验尸官随后宣布了调查结果，断定科林·罗斯应对阿尔玛·特什基的死负责，并将其移交审判，以追究其谋杀罪。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，一名女子站出来向警方上交了一些东西。

sentences.zh: 她在富茨克雷路上行驶时，在排水沟里发现了一块六英寸见方的蓝色布料。

sentences.en: The police believed it was part of the dress
sentences.zh: 警方认为这是阿尔玛·特什基在遇害当天所穿裙子的一部分。

sentences.en: Alma Tershki was wearing on the day she was murdered.
sentences.zh: 这一发现增加了科林·罗斯对其狱友西德尼·哈丁所做供述的可信度，

sentences.en: The discovery added validity to the alleged confession that Colin Ross gave to his fellow inmate,
sentences.zh: 并进一步加强了针对他的案件。

sentences.zh: 审判于次月，即二月开始。

sentences.zh: 这起案件已成为维多利亚州历史上最臭名昭著的刑事案件之一，法庭内座无虚席。

sentences.en: Those who missed out on a seat lingered outside the court, waiting for minute-by-minute updates.
sentences.zh: 没能抢到座位的人徘徊在法庭外，等待着每分钟的最新消息。

sentences.zh: 对于墨尔本人来说，这场审判不过是走个过场。

sentences.zh: 普遍的共识是，科林·罗斯有罪。

sentences.zh: 科林被带进法庭，他坚定地宣布自己无罪。

sentences.zh: 所有曾在死因研讯中作证的证人都再次出现在谋杀案的审判现场。
